issues.title: ISPathFindAction is nil when unlocking a vehicle
issues.note: NeatLockpick_Unlock.lua uses ISPathFindAction without requiring "Vehicles/TimedActions/ISPathFindAction" first; whether it is loaded depends on what ran before. The log line names no mod (KahluaThread.call > require), so the Monitor can blame a neighbour. The Studio package carries the file with the require added.
issues.log: ERROR: ... attempted index: ISPathFindAction of non-table
issues.source: PZ Mod Studio, verified in the game's console.txt on 42.21 (2026-10-18)
